subject: Post-demo: Finly privacy intake + DPA module recommendation
messages:
From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
To: marta.kozlowska@finly.com, privacy@finly.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Finly privacy intake + DPA module recommendation

Hi Marta — great to meet you and the Finly team today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side (keeps concise):

1) Call summary
- Product fit: Finly would use Redwood for PDF extraction summarization and anonymized embedding storage for transaction tagging.
- Data residency: EU-only required; noted.
- Regulatory flags: GDPR with potential HIT-style data flows (no PHI expected today).

2) Immediate asks you raised
- DPA and SCC module preference (controller/processor roles)
- SOC 2 report timing and scope
- Standard vendor security questionnaire kickoff
3) Our proposed path
- Attached: a short DPA request form for your legal team to confirm the data roles and modules we should include. We typically propose Redwood as processor in a processor-only flow, but we can accept controller+processor mapping if Finly needs us to take on additional responsibilities.
- I asked Ben (SE) and Priyom (privacy lead) to join this thread to confirm SOC 2 scope and provide the starter security questionnaire.
- Next steps: please review the attached DPA request and return with your preference for SCC modules (Standard, VSQ add-on, or Custom Annex). If helpful, we can schedule a 30-min legal sync next week.

Thanks — copied below for internal context.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

Attachments:
- Finly_DPA_Request_v1.pdf (pdf) — short form to indicate controller/processor choice and required SCC modules

On Tue, 3 Aug 2027 at 14:05 Marta Kozlowska <marta.kozlowska@finly.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the demo, Stephanie — the retrieval/embedding demo was helpful.
> 
> A few notes: we need EU-only hosting, and our legal team will want to see the DPA and your SOC 2 Type II report. Also want to confirm whether Redwood will be considered a processor or whether we need a hybrid controller mapping for certain enrichment jobs.
> 
> I copied privacy@finly.com and would appreciate the DPA starter and questionnaire. Can you send through today?
> 
> Marta
> Head of Integrations, Finly
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com, marta.kozlowska@finly.com
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Finly privacy intake + DPA module recommendation

Thanks, Steph — looping in a quick note on SOC 2 and SCC options from SE perspective.

Marta / Finly team — short answers up front:
- SOC 2: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report covering our hosted API and dedicated deployments; we can provide the latest report under NDA. The report covers availability, security, and confidentiality controls relevant to your use-case.
- DPA/SCC: For most customers in fintech we recommend processor role + SCC Module 2 (typical processing) with the VSQ add-on only if Finly requires specific logging/evidence retention beyond our standard 12-month trace logs.
- EU hosting: we support region pinning to eu-west-1 and can attest in the DPA.

I'll attach a one-page SOC 2 FAQ and the starting security questionnaire in a separate message.
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, marta.kozlowska@finly.com
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Finly privacy intake + DPA module recommendation

Hi all — attaching the vendor security questionnaire (V3) and a short DPA request template to capture whether Finly prefers Redwood as processor-only or wants controller/processor split. If Finly indicates processor-only, the DPA will include standard SCC modules and EU hosting pin. If they require controller mapping for enrichment jobs, we need to flag obligations for data deletion timelines and data subject request procedures.

Attachment stub:
- Finly_Security_Questionnaire_v3.xlsx (xlsx)
Proposed quick intake fields for Finly to complete:
- Primary contact for privacy/legal (name + email)
- Use cases that involve personal data and whether those are pseudonymized/anonymized
- Required SCC module preference (Standard / VSQ add-on / Custom Annex)
- Retention expectations for embeddings / logs
I recommend a 30-min legal sync after they return the form so we can agree SCC modules and sign DPA.
Thanks,
Priyom Das
Privacy & Compliance, Redwood Inference
From: Marta Kozlowska <marta.kozlowska@finly.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: privacy@finly.com
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 10:17:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Finly privacy intake + DPA module recommendation

Thanks, team.

I ran the starter DPA request by our privacy lead and we have the following provisional responses:
- Preferred role: Redwood as processor (Finly = controller) for the initial ingestion + embedding flows. We may revisit a controller/processor split for enrichment pipelines in Q4.
- SCC modules: agree to Standard SCC + request the VSQ add-on only if you can demonstrate extended logging retention for 24 months.
- SOC 2: happy to sign an NDA to receive the Type II report.

I attached our preliminary answers to the questionnaire and a short note from our privacy lead on retention. Can you confirm Redwood's default embedding retention window and whether you provide a deletion API for customer-managed deletions?

Marta
Head of Integrations, Finly
> On Wed, 4 Aug 2027 at 09:08 ben_carter@redwood.com wrote:
> > Thanks, Steph — looping in a quick note on SOC 2 and SCC options from SE perspective.
From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
To: marta.kozlowska@finly.com, privacy@finly.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 13:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Finly privacy intake + DPA module recommendation

Hi Marta — thanks for the quick turn on the questionnaire. A few quick clarifications and commitments from our side: 

- Retention: default embedding retention is 90 days for hosted evaluation; for production customers we configure retention per contract — we can add a 24-month retention profile behind VSQ add-on with explicit logging and archiving if needed.
- Deletion API: yes — Redwood provides a customer-controlled deletion API and documented DSAR flows; I'll paste link to the docs below and include a short excerpt in the legal package.
- SOC 2: Ben, can you confirm the NDA link so Finly can access the full Type II report?
Proposed next steps:
1) I'll send the DPA (processor-only, SCC Standard) for review; add VSQ add-on clause as an optional annex pending your confirmation on 24-month retention.
2) Finly signs the NDA so we can provide SOC 2 (Ben to share).
3) Schedule 30-min legal sync (I propose Tue 10 Aug 2027 at 09:30 CEST) — let me know if that works.

Doc links:
- https://docs.redwood.com/privacy/deletion-api
Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hello Stephanie / Redwood team —

We received the questionnaires and confirmed internally: Finly prefers Redwood to be processor for initial flows. We also confirm interest in the VSQ add-on if Redwood can commit to 24-month logging/archival for embedding evidence. We are completing the NDA now — expect to return signed by EOD Monday.
A couple of follow-up asks for the DPA draft:
- Please explicitly call out EU region pinning in the DPA and the SCC Module configuration.
- For data subject requests: include Redwood's SLA for DSAR acknowledgement and escalation path.

We are available for the proposed legal sync on Tue 10 Aug 2027 at 09:30 CEST.
